entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Should I come back later?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You seem to be doing well.
Have a seat.[clr 27]
I'll make you some coffee.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Sure...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're used to being back in the real[n]world again, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Your stay at the reformatory isn't[n]something that can be pardoned by[n]an ex-post facto report, you know.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: By the way, do you know why[n]I stopped by?
Valentine's?[clr 27]
Some bad news?
Little guinea pig time?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Mmm...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...No, not that.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We're done with the trials.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Here...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I ordered it from overseas. There's[n]nothing in it that could harm you.
Thanks.
What's inside?
Is it filled with love?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're welcome.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: If the label's correct, it's chocolate.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You have no right to decline it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're all I've thought about since we[n]stopped seeing each other...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's been a while since the last time[n]we did this.
You're right.
How's work been?
I've missed you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I look forward to your continued[n]patronage.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I've had a bit of free time recently.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What a coincidence. Same here.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That new medicine for that girl I told[n]you about has been working really well.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: And it's all thanks to my little guinea pig.
I should tell Takemi that[n]I'm going home...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What do you wanna talk about?
I'll be returning to my hometown.
I'm going home.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're a completely different person[n]from when I first met you. You've[n]become a man.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So, you're leaving next month, huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I think it'd be a bit too far for me to[n]make a house call.
Sorry.
It's going to be lonely.[clr 27]
Want to tag along?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, the next time something happens,[n]call me right away.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll see you on my off days.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I appreciate the invite, but...[n]I have patients to attend to.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was never really into younger guys...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You made me wait a long time...[n]so this is okay, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I won't take no for an answer.
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Takemi...
